title: Variable name with spaces
description:
Error-prone rule — a variable name contains a space. FileMaker accepts it in the name field of Set Variable, but every read has to use the ${name with spaces} notation; a plain $name with spaces silently reads something else. Covers local, global, Let() and MBS superglobal variables.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "ListScriptsWithBadVariableNames" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: The name field of Set Variable is literal text, the reading side is a formula — so a space is allowed on the writing side but changes the parsing on the reading side. What looks like one variable becomes two, and neither the compiler nor the runtime complains.
rule.remediation: Rename the variable without spaces (underscores read just as well) and update the reads. Where the name has to stay, make every read use the ${…} notation.
